title: 2000 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: Triangles \(ABC,\) \(ADE,\) and \(EFG\) are all equilateral. Points \(D\) and \(G\) are midpoints of \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{AE},\) respectively. If \(AB = 4,\) what is the perimeter of figure \(ABCDEFG?\)

solutions.text:
The large equilateral triangle has side length \(4,\) the middle one has side length \(2,\) and the smaller one has side length \(1.\)

The perimeter is therefore \[ \begin{gather*} CB + CD + DE + EF \\ {}+ FG + GA + AB \\ = 4 + 4 + 2 + 2 + 1 \\ + 1 + 1 = 15. \end{gather*} \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
